title: RailShack · Command Center
description: One screen for all 50 microservices: health, traffic, the booking journey, the data layer and firing alerts.

options.content:
🚆 Command Center
50 microservices · AWS EKS Auto Mode · PostgreSQL + Redis · Prometheus + Grafana
RailShack · a DevOps Shack project · devopsshack.com

panels.title: Services up
panels.description: Distinct services Prometheus can scrape. 50 means every service has at least one healthy pod.

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Share of requests that did not return a 5xx.

panels.title: Requests / second
panels.description: All requests across all 50 services.

panels.title: Avg response time
panels.description: Average time a service takes to answer one request.

panels.title: Bookings / minute
panels.description: Successful bookings (HTTP 201 from the booking service).

panels.title: Pods ready
panels.description: RailShack pods passing their readiness probe.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: EC2 instances in the cluster. EKS Auto Mode adds and removes them as pods need room.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: RailShack alert rules currently firing. The table at the bottom lists them.

panels.title: Traffic by status class
panels.description: Every request, split by HTTP status class. Red is what users feel as 'something went wrong'.

panels.title: Error rate and response time
panels.description: Error rate (left, %) and average response time (right, seconds).

panels.title: Journey, per minute
panels.description: Each step of a user's trip through RailShack, as successful requests per minute to the service that does it.

panels.title: Bookings vs failed payments, per minute
panels.description: When payments fail, bookings fail with them. This is the business view of an incident.

panels.title: Requests / second by domain
panels.description: The 50 services grouped into the six business domains of RailShack.

panels.title: Error rate by domain
panels.description: Share of 5xx responses in each domain.

panels.title: Avg response time by domain
panels.description: Average response time in each domain.

panels.title: Service health
panels.description: Every service in one table. Click a column to sort. Red cells need attention.

targets.expr: (sum by (service) (rate(railshack_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace",code=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (service) (rate(railshack_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace"}[5m]))) / clamp_min(sum by (service) (rate(railshack_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: PostgreSQL
panels.description: The source of truth: accounts, bookings, My Trips.

panels.title: Redis
panels.description: The cache in front of PostgreSQL. Losing it costs speed, never data.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of cache lookups answered by Redis without touching PostgreSQL.

panels.title: DB connections
panels.description: Open connections to the railshack database (auth, pnr, booking-history pods).

panels.title: Cached keys
panels.description: Keys in Redis right now: pnr:<PNR> and trips:<user> copies.

panels.title: Rows written (since start)
panels.description: Rows inserted into the railshack database since PostgreSQL started (users, bookings, trips).

panels.title: RailShack alerts firing now
panels.description: Rules from the railshack-alerts PrometheusRule. Empty is good.
